object_description: compact volume turned against the surrounding geometries
design_condition: The compact building is placed in the south-eastern part of the site and turned slightly from the prevailing geometries to mediate between adjacent urban bodies while preserving a northern green belt.

positive.statement: The compact structure generates differentiated outdoor spaces for the school and the neighborhood.

position.rationale: Compact massing leaves distinct peripheral outdoor regions visible in the top view.

positive.statement: Its position mediates between the adjacent green and compact urban bodies.

position.rationale: The slightly rotated compact volume is clearly visible and spatially central to the mediation.

positive.statement: A comprehensible route ensures that the new school and the green spaces are comprehensively connected to the surrounding area.

position.rationale: The surrounding circulation route is approximated along the building’s western open edge.

positive.statement: The extra heights create exciting visual links between different uses and floors.

position.rationale: Vertical connections are inferred from the repeated elevated bands and tall massing.

positive.statement: The architectural expression is kept simple and the compact volume is designed uniformly on all sides.

position.rationale: Symmetric horizontal massing and consistent elevations are directly visible across views.

negative.statement: The all-weather area on an embankment makes the zoning between the green belt and the defined school spaces appear too dominant.

position.rationale: The embankment and sports area are not distinguishable, so a northern peripheral site anchor is used.

negative.statement: The extra heights produce a large volume with a negative impact on construction costs and environmental sustainability.

position.rationale: Elevations visibly show the enlarged vertical extent above the regular horizontal bands.

negative.statement: The larger horizontal openings appear too crowded in their proportions.

position.rationale: Opening proportions are assigned to the visible horizontal facade bands.

negative.statement: The relationship between the building structure and the terrain and surroundings is not convincing, appearing undifferentiated and arbitrary.

position.rationale: The critique concerns the building’s interface with the surrounding ground edge.

negative.statement: The design is unable to compensate for its high land consumption with clear interior added value.

position.rationale: The compact volume’s footprint is directly visible and anchors the land-consumption judgment.
